params = {'xL': -2.4, 'xR': 2.4, 'nx': 40, 'kx': 4.2, 'mx': 0.0, 'Sxx': 1.0, 'yL': -1.8, 'yR': 1.8, 'ny': 10, 'ky': 3.1, 'my': 0.0, 'Syy': 0.25, 'rho': 0.4, 'x0': 0.3, 'y0': -0.25, 'wx': 0.45, 'wy': 0.5, 'isp': 21, 'jsp': 6, 'fsp': 0.35, 'dt': 0.05, 'nt': 6}; import numpy as np; nx=int(params['nx']); ny=int(params['ny']); hx=(params['xR']-params['xL'])/nx; hy=(params['yR']-params['yL'])/ny; cx=params['xL']+(np.arange(1,nx+1)-0.5)*hx; cy=params['yL']+(np.arange(1,ny+1)-0.5)*hy; X,Y=np.meshgrid(cx,cy,indexing='ij'); q=np.exp(-((X-params['x0'])**2/(2*params['wx']**2)+(Y-params['y0'])**2/(2*params['wy']**2))); q=(1.0-params['fsp'])*q/(q.sum()*hx*hy); q[int(params['isp'])-1,int(params['jsp'])-1]+=params['fsp']/(hx*hy); p=q.reshape(-1)
assert np.allclose(float(composite_step_density(params, p).min()), target)
